topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: When I found out my child had the same teacher I had, a wave of mixed emotions washed over me. I should be happy, relieved even, knowing how much Mr. Thompson shaped me, his lessons reaching far beyond the curriculum. Yet, there's a heaviness in my chest, a quiet concern that perhaps the world isn't as changed as I hoped. I can't help but wonder if my child will navigate the same challenges, the same doubts, under his guidance. It's a bittersweet comfort, this familiarity, but I wish for something new, something better, for them.
